projects.title: Al-Khaliji Real Estate — Social Media Post Design
projects.description: A professional social media post designed for Al-Khaliji Real Estate to promote real estate investment and communicate the brand's services in a modern, trustworthy, and visually engaging way. The design combines a dark architectural background with a refined blue and orange color palette to create a premium real estate aesthetic.

images.alt: Al-Khaleeji Real Estate social media post
images.label: Social Media Design

projects.challenge: Create a professional social media advertisement for Al-Khaliji Real Estate that promotes real estate investment and highlights the company's key services while maintaining a modern and trustworthy visual appearance.
projects.approach: I developed a premium visual composition using a dark architectural environment as the main background, supported by a blue and orange color palette. The layout combines Arabic promotional typography, service icons, contact information, and real estate imagery to create a clear visual hierarchy while maintaining a strong corporate feel.
projects.result: The final design delivers a modern and professional social media advertisement that communicates Al-Khaliji Real Estate's services clearly and builds a sense of trust and credibility. The combination of architectural imagery, strong typography, and contrasting brand colors creates an engaging visual suitable for real estate marketing campaigns.

projects.title: Al-Khaleegi Real Estate — Logo Design
projects.description: A modern and luxurious logo design created for Al-Khaleegi Real Estate, a real estate and investment brand. The identity combines architectural forms with Arabic visual elements to communicate trust, stability, growth, and professionalism while maintaining a premium and distinctive appearance.
projects.challenge: Design a distinctive and professional logo for Al-Khaleegi Real Estate that reflects the company's focus on real estate investment while establishing a sense of trust, stability, luxury, and long-term growth.
projects.approach: I developed the logo around a stylized architectural skyline to represent the real estate industry and the idea of growth and development. The combination of gold and dark tones creates a luxurious and premium appearance, while the Arabic typography reinforces the brand's local identity and connection to the regional market.
projects.result: The final logo presents Al-Khaleegi Real Estate as a modern, trustworthy, and premium real estate brand. The architectural symbol and refined gold treatment create a strong visual identity that can be applied across digital platforms, marketing materials, and corporate branding.

projects.title: Al-Khaliji Agricultural Reclamation Co. — Social Media Post Design
projects.description: A professional social media post designed for Al-Khaliji Agricultural Reclamation Co. to promote its agricultural land reclamation and development services. The design uses a vibrant green visual direction, agricultural imagery, and structured service sections to communicate the company's capabilities and commitment to sustainable agricultural development.

images.alt: Al-Khaliji Agricultural Reclamation Co. — Social Media Post Design
images.label: Social media design

projects.challenge: Create an engaging social media design for Al-Khaliji Agricultural Reclamation Co. that highlights its agricultural services, land development capabilities, and commitment to supporting modern and sustainable agriculture.
projects.approach: I built the design around a strong agricultural visual theme using a green color palette and a wide farmland image as the main visual. The services were organized into three clear sections, supported by custom-style icons and concise Arabic messaging to make the information easy to scan while maintaining a professional corporate appearance.
projects.result: The final design presents the company's agricultural services in a clear, professional, and visually engaging format. The combination of natural imagery, green tones, structured information, and strong typography creates a cohesive social media advertisement suited to the agricultural and land reclamation industry.
